title: Final Reminder: Extended Fee Submission Deadline Ends May 2, 2026
text:
Final Reminder: Fee Submission Deadline

Students are hereby reminded to avail the extended deadline for fee submission, which is valid until May 2, 2026. As approved by the Honorable Vice Chancellor, the late fee has been completely waived for this period.

All students are strongly advised to take advantage of this final opportunity and ensure that their outstanding dues are cleared within the given timeframe. It is important to note that failure to submit fees by the revised deadline may result in a fine of Rs. 1,000/- per day and suspension of admission in accordance with university policy.

📌 Need Assistance?

For any queries or support regarding fee submission, students are encouraged to contact the Students’ Cell at the Treasurer’s Office.
